en.text:
Decreases Class Ability Regeneration Speed by 50% for 19 seconds upon Class Ability usage.

Grants the following to <strand/>Threaded Specters:
• <pve 50% /> <pvp [25%] /> Damage Resistance (bypassed by damage from you)
• 34% increased duration
• 2 Perched <strand/>Threadlings

Perched <strand/>Threadlings are released when the <strand/>Specter takes 40 damage. Destroying the Specter releases both <strand/>Threadlings.

Being within 15 meters of your own <strand/>Specter grants the 'Hidden' buff which removes you from enemy radar.
